headlines.title: Trump’s IRS carveout threatens to hold up Todd Blanche attorney general nomination
headlines.description: Republican Sens. John Cornyn of Texas and Thom Tillis of North Carolina have complicated Blanche’s path to confirmation as attorney general.

headlines.title: Todd Blanche’s rocky road: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we dig into the uncertain paths forward for Todd Blanche’s attorney general nomination and the Iran war.

headlines.title: Trump vows retaliatory strike after failed Iranian attack
headlines.description: President Trump is vowing a retaliatory strike against Iran after the Iranian regime unsuccessfully attempted to attack U.S. troops. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Fauci pleads fifth during Covid hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci declined to answer lawmaker questions as he was grilled over his actions during the pandemic. NBC News’ Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: Trump announces renovations to Dulles International Airport in Washington, D.C.
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced renovations at Dulles International Airport in Washington, D.C., including the construction of new concourses while preserving the original terminal.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump announces plans for sprawling Dulles Airport makeover
headlines.description: The plans include redoing two of the concourses and removing the airport’s aging shuttles, known as “people movers.”

headlines.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Covid hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci declined to answer senators’ questions at a contentious hearing Wednesday on the origins of Covid and the government’s handling of the pandemic, saying he would invoke his Fifth Amendment right to avoid the possibility that Republicans use his testimony to prosecute him for perjury.

headlines.title: Trump reportedly issues menacing new threat after Iran targets U.S. forces in thwarted missile attack
headlines.description: The fighting shattered a brief period of calm after weeks of escalation between the U.S. and Iran over the strategic Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: James Comey legal team argues DOJ’s seashells case erodes ‘bedrock’ principles
headlines.description: It’s the second time the Trump administration has found a way to criminally charge the former FBI director, whom Trump has targeted for years.

headlines.title: Francesca Hong avoids attacks as Wisconsin Democrats meet for governor debate
headlines.description: The five Democratic candidates for governor in Wisconsin almost entirely refrained from lobbing attacks at one another during their only debate Tuesday night, even as the volatile race enters its final two weeks.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to overturn $83.3 million award in E. Jean Carroll defamation case
headlines.description: Lawyers for President Donald Trump argued that he had immunity for statements made while president.
